shortBio.en: Operatic metal throat who inherits Sabbath after Ozzy—and arrives already battle-tested in Rainbow.
shortBio.zh: 歌剧式金属嗓，在 Ozzy 之后接手 Sabbath——抵达前已在 Rainbow 身经百战。

whyHub.en: Rainbow → Black Sabbath: proof the logo can change singers and still summon thunder.
whyHub.zh: Rainbow → Black Sabbath：证明 logo 能换主唱，仍能召唤雷。

body.en: Dio is the counter-exhibit to 'the singer is the band.' Rainbow makes him a fantasy-metal narrator; Sabbath's Dio years reinvent the myth without erasing Ozzy's weather. Listeners pick sides; the chronicle keeps both tenures.
body.zh: Dio 是「主唱即乐队」的反例展品。Rainbow 让他成为幻想金属叙事者；Sabbath 的 Dio 年代重塑神话，却擦不掉 Ozzy 的天气。听众选边；编年史两边 tenure 都留。
